label: powers
definition: A relation between a trait causal node and a molecular machine: asserts that the subject is the energetic driver -- an ion gradient, an electrochemical potential, or a torque-generating process -- whose dissipation does the work that operates the object.
traits_addressed: covers 7 causal-graph edges across 6 trait records
observations: Range-correct replacement for RO:0002327 (enables) on GENE_OR_PROTEIN objects that are molecular machines: biolink gives enables the range 'biological process or activity', which a protein complex cannot satisfy (TraitMech#334). No RO relation fits, because RO models energetics at the process level while all five corpus objects are protein complexes -- the same gap METPO:2007804 (exports) and METPO:2007805 (imports) were minted for. The label is not a coinage: every one of the five #334 edge descriptions already used the verb 'power'; the gate also picks up two pre-existing proton_motive_force -> ATP synthase edges ('Ion motive force powers rotation of the flagellar motor'). object_types is gated to GENE_OR_PROTEIN because that is the whole point of the term -- an energetic driver feeding a PROCESS satisfies enables' range and must stay on RO:0002327.
